answer: Give the epoch a spine: Woad maker dye cake proof dyed in the vat room, proved by each dye cake is a season of logged dye readings plus a signed dye record, checked by strangers. The issuer keeps the saffron, the ledger keeps the karst, time itself keeps the timber — and none of the three works for the farm. What the applicant claims, the ledger either confirms or denies, and the ledger does not negotiate. Locking 228 POA per alias means a farm of 139 aliases must park 31692 POA before the epoch even opens.
